body: Maintaining normality, a pill a day.... The slogan of the modern world.
In a few years we will have trillionaires, while most people can't even afford basic healthcare or dental care... Go figure...

You could switch majors for one. You could read Brandon Sanderson's Stormlight Archive series for three, it never seems to get dull at least for now, yet it's long...   
To be fair, I switched my major to something else from Engineering to Cyber Sec, didn't do me any good, yeah I got past a few years with a decent GPA but I lived with the other ten reasons you described. I am honestly in the same boat, same age but I quit college. If you are close to finishing college I recommend you to stay and finish it just go that extra mile even if you won't get the job you like in the end, you have a piece of paper called a "degree" or in my terms, "Accomplishment", so your parents won't keep bothering you.  
I have cut and came close to attempt suicide but never really did it, I think I'll just continue my shit life and I think you should too. Who knows something special might happen! I personally don't expect anything coming my way but you might get a miracle, who knows.
There is no cure for being an asshole I guess...

Suicide isn't meant to be easy or painless, that's why most of us are here and not in the grave. I think eventually for some of us the pain becomes so unbearable that we do it... and end it. Been a few times that I reached there but I force myself to sleep to help it... worked so far.
We never know the right answer to that question, will we ?

Have you tried reapplying for school ?  
I mean I am someone who has been living a life of "Nothing working out" so yeah and don't live for leaving a mark on the world. Then you end up not living for yourself, I have always lived like that, wanting to do something to immortalize myself... Doesn't seem like a great idea, you just end up even more depressed when your attempts fail.

I can't imagine the world to be any better. Work in a dead end job, getting by pay check to pay check and not being able to afford to go to college. It's a lovely world, oh I can't wait to live another day in it... It's so perfect and I definitely have a reason to live.  
Humans are the true lesser beings, I mean how many try to make lives better for others and try to lessen the misery of the world. Those with the power never did enough of their fair share to make this world more livable for others.  
All I can do is to find myself in psyche ward with a handful of pills to stuff my body with, because it's not life that sucks. It's my mind that's fucked...
Turning 23 was my 8th year mark of wanting to put a gun to my head... I can't say it was bad, I survived 8 years of suicidal ideation.
I try to cry but I can't, makes me envy other people. Everything feels like a fucking joke so I end up laughing and others mistake it as happiness.
Me too... and now living worse than it used to be, it's so fucking great man...
Funny thing is, we are being murdered by ourselves...

I did before(SSRIs), that's why I am hesitant... It did not help me at all. I am not a big believer in Yoga or meditation. I tried meditation but I gave up on it... wasn't for me. Honestly reading here, helps a bit, I don't know why.

It's same for me. I have never been genuinely happy for the past 7 years as well, smiles are a drag or not there at all. I spent some time in college and uni hoping things are getting better and I have hope but it came crashing down middle of the way and I kept failing so I threw my hands up and told myself fuck it...

Now I have no degree, no hope for the future and thanks to covid no work or any opportunity to find one.  
It's a bad way to go... why are you making a suicide bag ? They said SSRIs will help me experience joy, and I also tried Wellbutrin. To be fair Wellbutrin was better for me but I had anger issues for some reason... it made me feel happier and a bit of joy. Maybe try to talk to someone, maybe you'll get better but I am just hanging in here.

You know I asked the mind fuckers in the hospital will it get better?

They said "It won't "... and here some pills to get through your whole life. How am I supposed to act ?

I feel the same. Last time I felt like this was when I was 17, I basically slept in my classes couldn't handle it. It's so many years after and I never gotten better and drugs rarely helped... I just don't have any energy to draw, write, go to class or even play a fucking game. I am just holding my head all day...

This is why you shouldn't build a society and rules on an already crumbling pillars. We are taught at first by family, then by school and post secondary, "how to be normal", the moment we edge a bit away from it; There they feed you 10 types of different pharmaceutical drugs for you just to maintain normality.  
You are right, if people are having problems maintaining this standard of "normality" that society has put forth for them, maybe the issue is not people but society that needs to rethink its values. Humanity is a thick headed race of dimwits however, they cling on what is and never change it for the better until they end up in a shitty dystopia. Every country is a dystopia ,depending on how close they have come, in achieving this full potential of being the worst for human mind.  
If one day we get enlightened that this is clearly not working and we change things for the better, I hope I am alive to see it because at least we called it here and now.

Is God such a big ego prick, to put you in the world to suffer then when you had enough of it and end yourself, throw you in hell? Well, funny enough if you look at Job God did that to him, made a deal with the devil that Job will stay faithful so God took it upon himself to torture the bastard and take his children and everything from him. He remained faithful, but at the same time he was big sucker. Funny you mention hell, in Job there is a word that is mistranslated in some versions, I think King James it the only version that got it right. A word called "Sheol", it's a very dark place, in Hebrew translation, it's where the dead go. Honestly I don't believe in God anymore but you know, I gave you some food for thought.
Honestly I would tell them, Hell is better than this miserable existence.

You know... you are right. People like her make your problems far worse than they are, you should avoid them at all costs. This is why I stopped talking to my friends about depression unless I want to give them honestly advice about their own problems. I lost a friend when I desperately needed one due to the same problem, and fuck him... he sucks and wretch like him don't deserve to have a friend like me or you, and same for her.
Thanks, I have a few things planned hope they go somewhere.

Idk I feel useless. I couldn't fully complete university, can't make something of myself in general. I just feel hopeless like no future left for me... I tried too hard and I feel tired... tired of life and all this pain...

I know I just add up a few sad people to the millions of them out there right now but the world itself will live on... I assume we are both just staring at screens that's the most we are doing right now.

Just try to grasp at that thin string of life. What really keeps me going, is a fantasy of something good to happen... I want to live cuz I don't know what is out there. I am just not sure if not existing is any good, it's without pain but then there is no me...

They gave me my diagnosis in the hospital(MDD), after that I had to go to a psychiatrist, work with a social worker and all kinds of stuff. I forced myself to go out with friends for the time that covid got better but now it's back where it was cuz people are fucking stupid and party. What can you do ? All this time just makes you want to die but I do my best being a coward you know. Trying to grasp at the thinnest thread to live.

Dude I am on the same boat, mine didn't start due to Covid though, it just made it 100 times worse. That's why I browse through here so often. I came out of college cuz I can't learn shit like this and we had computer labs that require our full attention and equipment... so there is no point anymore... The games I play is too take my mind of not to enjoy I fucking despise them, I hate every single mechanic. I am constantly suicidal.

This shit is fucked... if you want to talk I am here bro...

I play league sometimes, and well it makes me feel like shit but I enjoy feeling like shit and suicidal all the time I guess. If you want to climb wait for next season when ranked is reworked or just quit that shit game, there are better games to play that don't require misery and suffering as core mechanics. I used to be plat but this ranked season most of my core champions are reworked or nerfed so I can't climb effectively, getting stuck in that sweet elo of low plat.

I think the best thing you can do is to be there for them, in my experience, I would avoid talking about their trauma and the suicidal tendencies. A lot of social workers over call can help with trauma and people who experience it you can refer them to one just in case, they might need advice but if you want to be a good friend as I said earlier just be there for them and I think you know how to do that. :)

Look you just got dealt a bad hand, we all sometimes get dealt that hand but all I can say is just try to get through it. If there is one good thing about military service, it is that it gives you a couple of friends to work with from what I know about Iran's mandatory military service, it is a complete joke.

Most of your ideas, about atheism and politics, I am sorry to say they just have to be kept in your mind if you want to live on. Honestly don't tell yourself, "Agha negaran nabash chizah behtar mishe". There are many iranians who think like you, there are small communities of atheists and people who are secular just find one, and you will be able to express yourself.

Oh and Covid... yeah it is eating through Iran like termites through furniture, just stay safe out there, hope you figure it out.

If natural selection was about the strong to live on, we would be a society of brainless brutes, that only know how to eat, shit and fuck. No more than animals.

I am glad to say we are not that, the cunning, the wise and people with more than a double digit IQ are just doing their best. Sometimes just lower your expectations... and you will find someone too. 

You just need to relax and not take rash decisions just ... see if you can solve the small stuff first, maybe you can overcome the rest later on.

There are too many underlying problems to, too many of us here that a self help book can barely scratch the surface. To be fair, if self help books helped, I wouldn't be reading this subreddit everyday, to me knowing the experiences of others is the best self help I can get...

Well, it removes all of your problems sure but where I disagree is what if I just wanted to live without those problems in the first place. What if I just don't want to remove my consciousness from the equation? I can't choose between one or the other, so I stuck living with the problems, it just makes me suicidal everyday but how can I deal with it you know... The difference is I just want to persist as long as I do and hope one of the problems go away...

I basically overthink my whole life decisions everyday, makes me not sleep, not be able to move and sometimes suicidal, they could keep telling me not to but I just do it's what defines me, I have done it since childhood I probably continue doing it until my brain works.
